title: Regression models for ordinal compositional data
authors: Beniamino Cappelletti-Montano; Monica Musio; Nicola Piras
summary: We present a unified, transformation-free linear regression framework tailored for ordinal compositional data, such as distributions across educational levels or aggregate Likert-scale survey responses. Traditional log-ratio approaches often obscure interpretability, ignore the inherent ordering of categories, and struggle with boundary zero values. To overcome these limitations, we propose a deterministic model constrained to the space of column-stochastic transformation matrices, naturally preserving the fundamental geometry of the simplex.
